html:
After an amazing vacation on the beautiful Mui Ne beach, you may want to travel to Ho Chi Minh City for another trip in this bustling city or to Ho Chi Minh Airport. But you still don’t know which vehicle to take on this route. Then choose our Mui Ne To Ho Chi Minh Private Car, the excellent transfer service from Vietlook Travel, to have a comfortable trip with flexible stops and itinerary.

Mui Ne To Ho Chi Minh Distance

Ho Chi Minh City is one of the two largest economic centers of Vietnam. Tourists coming here can visit famous tourist attractions such as Ben Thanh Market, Notre Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, or Cu Chi Tunnels. In addition, some choose Saigon Airport (Tan Son Nhat Airport) to fly to other provinces for another visit or back to their country.

Tourists in Mui Ne going to Ho Chi Minh City have to travel a distance of about 205 km (~127 miles). This route is not too far, driving through CT01 Highway to Ho Chi Minh City will take you about 3.5-4 hours.

Or if you choose Saigon Airport as your destination, the distance is only 200 km (~124 miles). And it will take you about 3.5 hours by car. However, the road to the airport often has traffic jams, so the Mui Ne to Ho Chi Minh Airport travel time can be extended.

For this journey, tourists can choose to travel by taxi, bus, shared car, or private car. But for a convenient door-to-door trip with comfort and a flexible schedule, we highly recommend you choose our private car service. Then, you will no longer have to worry about the weather or traffic; just relax and enjoy the dedicated services from us.

MUI NE TO HO CHI MINH PRIVATE CAR SERVICE

Booking our private car service is very simple. You just need to fill out the form on our website. Or you can contact us via WhatsApp (+84) 98.339.3488. Then please provide us with some necessary information like the number of passengers, luggage and your other requirements for the trip. We will make a best-fit itinerary for you.

Traveling From Mui Ne To Saigon/ Saigon Airport By Car

Based on your booking, our driver will arrive at your hotel or resort in Mui Ne. He will arrive 10 minutes early so you don’t have to wait. When you meet him, the driver will greet you warmly and then take you to the car. He will help you carry your luggage and get you safely into the car. Once done, your trip from Mui Ne to Saigon by private car begins here.

On the way from Mui Ne, you will always feel relaxed while sitting in a spacious and clean car with many modern amenities. Also, being accompanied by an experienced driver makes you feel more secure. We always prioritize your safety throughout the trip to Ho Chi Minh City/ Airport.

Additionally, along the way, you can ask our driver to stop if you want to use the restroom, have a snack, drink coffee, or sightsee. He will always be happy and willing to stop at the location to suit your request which doesn’t affect your travel time much.

Moreover, traveling from Mui Ne to Ho Chi Minh, you can visit some famous attractions, such as Ta Cu Mountain, Van Thuy Tu Temple, or Po Sah Inư Tower. According to your request, our travel experts put your desired stops into your itinerary and make the visit match your schedule.

After all, you have arrived at Ho Chi Minh or Tan Son Nhat Airport after nearly 4 hours of travel. Upon arrival, our friendly driver will help you unload your luggage from the car. After he has made sure nothing is left in the car, your whole journey from Mui Ne to Ho Chi Minh by car officially ends.
